# ACTUAL / SIGNAL ARCHIVE

> ACTUAL presents Signal Archive: three studies in form, gesture, and afterimage.

Canonical website: https://actual.ltd/

Contact: hello@actual.ltd

Legal entity: ACTUAL LTD.

Registered office: 25 Chidlom, Ploenchit, Lumpini, Patumwan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

All nine artworks in this visual archive are from The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access collection and are marked Public Domain (CC0). Images are locally optimized for presentation; the collection pages below are the canonical records.

## Record 001 / FORM

Matter takes a position.

Environment: Jacques Louis David, The Death of Socrates, 1787.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436105

Figure: Marble statue of a kouros (youth), Greek, Attic, ca. 590–580 BCE.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/253370

Object: Andokides, Terracotta amphora (jar), ca. 530 BCE.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/255154

## Record 002 / GESTURE

The body invents the line.

Environment: Edgar Degas, The Dance Class, 1874.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/438817

Figure: Edgar Degas, The Little Fourteen-Year-Old Dancer, modeled 1881; cast 1922.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/196439

Object: Bertrand, Fan, mid-19th century.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/209540

## Record 003 / AFTERIMAGE

Light outlives the moment.

Environment: Vincent van Gogh, Wheat Field with Cypresses, 1889.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436535

Figure: Vincent van Gogh, Self-Portrait with a Straw Hat, 1887.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436532

Object: Vincent van Gogh, Irises, 1890.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Public Domain / Open Access.
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436528
